As he stood watching them, the fish suddenly leaped up from the ground; and having flopped back into the water, swam away.

storyline: One of the many sea-gods who ruled under Neptune was Glaucus, who was once a poor fisherman, and earned his living by selling the fish that he caught each day.
As he stood watching them, the fish suddenly leaped up from the ground; and having flopped back into the water, swam away.
Curious to see whether it was the grass that gave them this extraordinary power, Glaucus chewed a bit of it himself, and immediately he felt an irresistible desire to plunge into
Fearlessly he dived beneath the waves, and soon found no difficulty in keeping under water, for the ocean seemed now to be his native element.
He saw his beard turning a lovely sea-green; and he found that his hair, grown suddenly long and green, was trailing out behind him.
His arms were azure-colored, and his legs became a fish's tail; but he felt no regrets over losing his human form, and stayed contentedly in the ocean.
